changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwDepartment AS SELECT d.id, d.facility_id, d.name, d.created_by, d.created_date, d.type, d.last_modified_by, d.last_modified_date, d.appointable, d.code, d.phone_number, d.email, d.encounter_type, d.is_active, d.has_medical_sheets, d.has_nurse_medical_sheets, d.parallel_capacity_enabled, d.parallel_capacity_value, d.default_duration_minutes, d.default_buffer_before_minutes, d.default_buffer_after_minutes, d.require_practitioner, d.require_billing, d.require_pre_assessment, d.working_days FROM public.department d;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwDepartment TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON reports.vwDepartment FROM report_user;
